primarySources.contract: Authors is a free-form supplied person list, separately consumed from numbered AuthorList Last/First roles.
The existing native free-form Authors value or the numbered list supplies displayed authors. Their HTML and COinS need not be byte-identical.

sourceConstruction: Split only 2 to 20 semicolon-delimited supplied personal names. A whole name may have one internal comma with nonempty personal-name sides. Keep each complete supplied name, order, every other citation field, native family and reference association. No comma-based person splitting. Require the complete independently constructed target association, not a returned candidate patch.
vetoes: More than one comma inside a person, empty surname or given-name side
Unproved, nested, institutional, numeric or et-al list
Competing person/list/display roles, including supplied blank values
Changed name bytes, order, title, date, page, URL, reference name or group
